name: Sakura no Sakukoro -Haru no Ashioto Pleasurable Box-
original_name: さくらのさくころ - はるのあしおと Pleasurable Box -
source:
This is a fan disk of "Haru no Ashioto". There are mainly four parts in this item "Sakura no Sakukoro". "Short Story Part", a sequel to "Haru no Ashioto", "Original Animation Part", "Haruo to Hanafuda" and "Accessory Collection".

[From [url=http://www.himeyashop.com/product_info.php/cPath/30_46/products_id/3525]Himeya Shop[/url]]
translation:
这是《春之足音》的Fan Disc。《さくらのさくころ》主要分为四部分：作为《春之足音》续篇的‘短篇故事篇’、‘原创动画篇’、‘春男与花札’，以及‘附加内容合集’。

[摘自[url=http://www.himeyashop.com/product_info.php/cPath/30_46/products_id/3525]Himeya Shop[/url]]
